note: Hadi's grounding corpus. Qur'an entries name verses only: the app prints Arabic and English from assets/quran/quran.json. Hadith entries are summaries or short excerpts written for this app (not copied from sunnah.com); number, collection and grade were checked on sunnah.com on the date shown. Anything not listed here Hadi cannot cite. Not yet reviewed by a named scholar.

hadith.english: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than a traveller who finds his lost camel again.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: If you did not sin, Allah would replace you with a people who sin, seek forgiveness, and are forgiven.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man who had killed ninety-nine people asked whether he could still repent, and the hadith tells us the door was open to him.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: None of you should die except while thinking well of Allah.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, harm or distress touches a Muslim, even a thorn's prick, but Allah expiates some of his sins for it.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Allah says: I am just as My servant thinks I am. If he comes to Me walking, I go to him running.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet wept as his son Ibrahim was dying and said: “The eyes are shedding tears and the heart is grieved, and we will not say except what pleases our Lord.”
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Allah accepts the repentance of His servant until the soul reaches the throat.
hadith.grader: Darussalam (Tirmidhi himself calls it hasan gharib)

hadith.english: The best of believers are those who are best to their wives (summary of the narration from A’ishah).
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: The Prophet told the people of the Negus's death on the day he died, lined them up at the prayer ground and said four takbirs
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet told the women washing his daughter to wash her three or five times or more with water and lotus leaves, adding camphor at the end
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet was shrouded in three white Yemeni cotton sheets, without a shirt or a turban
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet told people to hurry with the dead body: if the person was righteous it is forwarding them to good, otherwise it is putting an evil off their necks
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Samurah ibn Jundab prayed behind the Prophet over a woman who had died in childbirth; he stood by the middle of the bier
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Talhah prayed a funeral prayer behind Ibn Abbas, who recited al-Fatihah and said it is the Prophet's tradition
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Zayd ibn Arqam usually said four takbirs over a funeral but once said five, and said the Prophet had done the same
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: 'Awf ibn Malik remembered the Prophet's du'a over a dead man: forgive him, have mercy on him, make his grave wide, wash him with water, snow and hail, admit him to Paradise and protect him from the torment of the grave and the Fire
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man who could not learn the Qur'an was told to say glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is most great, and there is no might nor strength but in Allah
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Ibn Umar said the Prophet prayed the optional prayers on his mount facing any direction, and witr too, but never the compulsory prayer on it
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: When the Prophet set out before noon he delayed Dhuhr until Asr time and prayed them together
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Imran ibn Husayn had piles and asked about the prayer; the Prophet said pray standing, if you cannot then sitting, if you cannot then on your side
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A'ishah said the Prophet never exceeded eleven rak'ahs at night in Ramadan or other months
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Huraira reported the Prophet finished after two rak'ahs by mistake, Dhul-Yadayn pointed it out, he prayed two more, gave the salam and made two prostrations
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said the prayer of one who passes wind or urine is not accepted until he does wudu
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar said the Prophet made zakat al-fitr a sa' of dates or barley on every Muslim, and ordered it be paid before people go out to the Eid prayer
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umar saw people praying in scattered groups in Ramadan and gathered them behind one reciter, saying what a good innovation this is
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ka'b ibn Ujrah said the companions asked the Prophet how to send blessings on him and his household; he told them to say: O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and his family as You sent on Ibrahim and his family, You are praiseworthy and glorious; and bless Muhammad and his family as You blessed Ibrahim and his family
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas was asked if the Prophet ever prayed with his shoes on and said yes
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said whoever forgets a prayer should pray it when he remembers it, there is no expiation but that; then he recited the verse about establishing prayer for My remembrance
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ubadah ibn as-Samit reported that the Prophet said the prayer of someone who does not recite the Opening of the Book is not valid
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Buhaina reported the Prophet stood after two rak'ahs without sitting and made two prostrations before giving the salam
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Mas'ud reported that the Prophet taught the tashahhud: greetings, prayers and good words are for Allah; peace be on you O Prophet; peace on us and on Allah's righteous servants; I bear witness there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is His servant and messenger
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas said the Prophet did not go out on the day of Eid al-Fitr until he had eaten some dates, an odd number
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet prayed the Eid of Adha and Eid of Fitr, then gave the khutbah after the prayer
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said to make witr your last prayer at night
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ali said the Prophet set three days and nights for a traveller and one day and one night for a resident
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ubadah reported the same: there is no prayer for one who does not recite Fatihat al-Kitab
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Sa'id reported the Prophet said that if one is in doubt about how much he prayed he should put the doubt aside, base it on what he is sure of and make two prostrations before the salam
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet gave the time of each prayer: Fajr until the sun starts to rise, Zuhr until Asr, Asr until the sun turns yellow, Maghrib until the twilight goes, Isha until half the night
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas reported the same: he who forgets the prayer should pray it when he remembers it
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umar asked about shortening when people were safe, and the Prophet said it is a charity Allah has given you, so accept it
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man asked about the night prayer: it is pairs of rak'ahs, and if you fear morning is near, pray one rak'ah to make your prayer an odd number
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said from his pulpit that people must cease to neglect the Friday prayer or Allah will seal their hearts and they will be among the negligent
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umm Habibah heard the Prophet say a house in Paradise for whoever prays twelve rak'ahs in a day and night: four before Zuhr and two after, two after Maghrib, two after Isha and two before Fajr
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Anas said the Companions used to wait for the night prayer until their heads dropped from dozing, then they prayed without making wudu
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Qatadah let a cat drink from his wudu water and said the Prophet said it is not unclean, it is one of those that go round among you
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: The Prophet said a man who imagined he had passed wind in prayer should not leave unless he hears a sound or smells something
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas said that when the Prophet went to relieve himself, he and another boy followed with a tumbler full of water
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said that when anyone goes to the lavatory he should neither touch his penis nor clean his private parts with his right hand
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Uthman called for water, washed his hands three times, rinsed his mouth and nose, washed his face and arms to the elbows three times, wiped his head and washed his feet to the ankles three times, and said the Prophet taught that whoever does wudu like this and prays two rak'ahs with full attention is forgiven his earlier sins
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said if a dog drinks from a vessel of one of you he must wash it seven times
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said a woman does not pray and does not fast when menstruating
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A Bedouin urinated in the mosque and the Prophet told them to leave him, then pour a bucket of water over the place, and said they were sent to make things easy
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha described the Prophet's bath after janabah: he washed his hands, made wudu as for prayer, ran wet fingers through the roots of his hair, poured three handfuls of water on his head, and then poured water over the rest of his body
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umm Sulaim asked if a woman needs a bath after a wet dream, and the Prophet said yes, if she notices a discharge
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said among five things given to him: the earth was made for him and his followers a place for prayer and a means of tayammum, so a person can pray wherever the time of prayer comes
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ammar told Umar that the Prophet said it would have been enough to strike the earth with his hands, blow in them, then wipe his face and hands
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Salman said the Prophet forbade facing the qibla at the time of excretion or urination, cleaning with the right hand or with fewer than three pebbles, or with dung or bone
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A'ishah said that in the time of the Prophet the women who had their courses were ordered to make up the fasts but not the prayers
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man asked the Prophet about wudu after mutton, and he said do it if you wish, and asked about camel meat and he said yes, do wudu
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Safwan ibn Assal reported the Prophet told them on a journey not to remove their socks for three days and nights except for janabah, but not for defecating, urinating or sleep
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: The Prophet is reported to have said the menstruating woman and the one in janabah do not recite anything of the Qur'an
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Anas said the Prophet used to break his fast with fresh dates before praying, or dry dates, or a few mouthfuls of water
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Ibn Umar reported the Prophet said when he broke his fast: thirst has gone, the veins are moist and the reward is sure if Allah wills
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: The Prophet told Laqit ibn Saburah to snuff water up freely unless he is fasting
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: The Prophet said whoever does not give up forged speech and evil actions, Allah has no need of his leaving his food and drink
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said to take suhoor as there is a blessing in it
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha said the Prophet used to kiss and embrace his wives while fasting and he had more control over his desires than any of you
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said that if somebody eats or drinks forgetfully he should complete his fast, for Allah gave him what he ate or drank
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man told the Prophet he was ruined because he had relations with his wife while fasting; the Prophet asked if he could free a slave, then fast two months, then feed sixty poor people
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said the people will remain on the right path as long as they hasten the breaking of the fast
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said that if it were not hard on his followers he would have ordered the siwak for every prayer
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Qatadah reported the Prophet was asked about fasting; he said he hoped fasting Arafah would atone for the preceding and coming year and fasting Ashura for the preceding year
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Ayyub reported the Prophet said whoever fasted Ramadan and followed it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he fasted perpetually
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said there is no zakat on less than five awaq of silver, nor on less than five camels or five wasqs of produce
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar said the Prophet made one sa' of dates or barley incumbent on everyone as zakat al-fitr, and the people then substituted half a sa' of wheat
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said whoever performs Hajj for Allah's pleasure and avoids sexual relations and sins returns as if born anew
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said Umrah is an expiation for the sins committed between it and the previous one, and the reward of an accepted Hajj is nothing except Paradise
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas reported the Prophet said a woman should not travel except with a mahram, and a man got up to say his wife was going for Hajj and he had enlisted for a battle, so the Prophet told him to go with his wife
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet told the people Allah had made Hajj obligatory; a man asked if it was every year, and he kept quiet three times and then said that had he said yes it would have been obligatory
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas reported the Prophet said no one should be alone with a woman except when a mahram is with her, and the woman should not travel except with a mahram
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jabir said the Prophet cursed the accepter of interest, its payer, the one who records it and the two witnesses, and said they are all equal
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man asked the Prophet whether they could do wudu with sea water; he said its water is pure and what dies in it is lawful food
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Talha heard the Prophet say angels of mercy do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture of a living creature
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said a woman entered the Fire because of a cat which she had tied, neither giving it food nor setting it free to eat from the vermin of the earth
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said whoever keeps a dog that is neither a watch dog nor a hunting dog will get a daily deduction of two qirat from his good deeds
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Amir or Abu Malik al-Ash'ari heard the Prophet say that some of his followers will treat as lawful fornication, silk, wine and musical instruments
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar reported the Prophet said to differ from the polytheists, let the beard grow and trim the moustache
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said Allah has cursed the lady who lengthens hair artificially or has it lengthened, and the one who tattoos or gets tattooed
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha said Abu Bakr protested at two girls singing in her house, and the Prophet said leave them, for there is an Eid for every people and this is our Eid
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar reported the Prophet said every intoxicant is khamr and every intoxicant is forbidden, and whoever drinks wine in this world and dies addicted to it without repenting will not be given a drink in the Hereafter
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jabir reported that Abu Quhafah came on the day of the conquest with hair white like hyssop, and the Prophet told them to change it with something but avoid black
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Some of the wives of the Prophet reported the Prophet said whoever goes to a diviner and asks him about anything, his prayer will not be accepted for forty nights
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Mu'awiyah al-Qushayri asked what is the wife's right over her husband; the Prophet said to feed her when you eat, clothe her when you clothe yourself, not strike her on the face and not revile her
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Thawban reported the Prophet said if any woman asks her husband for divorce without a strong reason, the odour of Paradise will be forbidden to her
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: The Prophet said command a boy to pray when he reaches the age of seven years, and when he becomes ten, beat him for prayer
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: An-Nu'man ibn Bashir said his father gave him a gift, and the Prophet asked whether he had given the like of it to every one of his sons
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: It is not permissible for a man to be alone with a woman
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said a woman is married for four things: her wealth, her family status, her beauty and her religion, so marry the religious one
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said a matron should not be given in marriage without consulting her, and a virgin not without her permission, which is her silence
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: None of you should flog his wife as he flogs a slave and then have sexual intercourse with her in the last part of the day
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The wife of Thabit ibn Qais said she did not blame him for his character or religion but disliked behaving in an un-Islamic manner if she stayed with him, and the Prophet asked her to give back the garden and told Thabit to accept it
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A man asked the Prophet who is more entitled to the best companionship, and he said your mother three times and then your father
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Whoever is not merciful to others will not be treated mercifully
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said no obedience for evil deeds, obedience is required only in what is good
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Samurah reported the Messenger of Allah forbade celibacy
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: The best of you is the one who is best to his wife, and I am the best of you to my wives
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: The Prophet said do not beat the female slaves of Allah, and later said that seventy women had come to the family of Muhammad complaining about their husbands, and that those men are not the best of you
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abu Huraira reported the Prophet said act kindly towards women, and a believing man should not hate a believing woman: if he dislikes one of her characteristics, he will be pleased with another
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A'isha reported that the Prophet never beat anyone with his hand, neither a woman nor a servant, except when fighting in the cause of Allah
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Huraira reported the Prophet said let him be humbled into dust, he who sees his parents in old age but does not enter Paradise
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jahimah asked to go out and fight and the Prophet asked if he had a mother, and told him to stay with her, for Paradise is beneath her feet
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Thabit ibn Qais hit his wife and broke her arm, and the Prophet sent for him and told him to take what she owed him and let her go
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Musa narrated the Messenger of Allah said there is no marriage except with a wali
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abu Hurairah narrated the Prophet said the most complete of the believers in faith is the one with the best character, and the best of you are those who are best to your women
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: In the farewell Hajj the Prophet told the people to be good to women, and if they commit clear misconduct, to abandon their beds and beat them with a beating that is not harmful
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abdullah reported the Prophet wore a gold ring, then threw it away when people copied him and wore a silver ring instead
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas reported the Messenger of Allah saw a man wearing a gold signet ring, pulled it off and threw it away, saying one of you wishes for a live coal from Hell and puts it on his hand
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Musa reported the Messenger of Allah said wearing silk and gold has been made unlawful for the males of my Ummah and lawful for its females
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: A'isha reported the Prophet said the best of condiments is vinegar
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas reported a time limit was prescribed for clipping the moustache, cutting the nails, plucking the hair under the armpits and shaving the pubes, that it should not be neglected for more than forty nights
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Qays ibn Asim came to the Prophet intending to embrace Islam, and the Prophet commanded him to take a bath with water boiled with the leaves of the lote tree
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Ali ibn Abi Talib narrated the Prophet said if only one day of this time remained, Allah would raise up a man from my family who would fill this earth with justice as it has been filled with oppression
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Al-Miqdam ibn Ma'dikarib narrated the Prophet said I have been given the Qur'an and something like it, yet the time is coming when a man replete on his couch will say keep to the Qur'an, what you find in it permissible treat as permissible, and what you find prohibited treat as prohibited
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr reported a man asked the Prophet which deeds of Islam are good, and he said to feed the poor and greet those whom you know and those whom you do not know
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha said the Prophet died while his iron armor was mortgaged to a Jew for thirty sa of barley
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha said the revelation began with true dreams, then he loved seclusion and used to worship in the cave of Hira, and returned to Khadijah
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha asked the Prophet about the hardest day and he said it was the day at Aqaba when he went to Ibn Abd Yalil and he did not respond, and the angel of the mountains offered to let two mountains fall on them, and he said no, hoping Allah would bring from them those who worship Allah alone
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Huraira reported the Prophet said, by Him in whose hands is my soul, the son of Mary will soon descend among you and judge mankind justly
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Dhar reported the Prophet described how Jibreel opened his chest and washed it with Zamzam, ascended with him through the heavens, and Allah enjoined fifty prayers, which were reduced to five, and Allah said they are equal to fifty in reward
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah reported the Prophet said the best people are those living in my generation, and then those who will follow them, and then those who will follow the latter
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas said the Prophet started receiving the Divine Inspiration at the age of forty, stayed in Makkah for thirteen years, was ordered to migrate, lived as an emigrant for ten years and died at sixty-three
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Al-Bara said they used to say that the warriors of Badr were over three hundred and ten, as many as the companions of Saul who crossed the river with him
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umar ibn Abi Salama said the Prophet told him to mention the name of Allah, eat with his right hand and eat from what is nearest to him
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Umar reported the Prophet said Islam is based on five: to testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is Allah's Messenger, to offer prayer, to pay zakat, to perform Hajj, and to fast in Ramadan
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas ibn Malik narrated the Prophet said seeking knowledge is a duty upon every Muslim
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Amr ibn al-As reported the Prophet asked him, Are you not aware that Islam wipes out all the previous misdeeds?
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas reported the Prophet said he was brought al-Buraq, mounted it and came to the Temple in Jerusalem, tethered it to the ring used by the prophets, entered the mosque and prayed two rak'ahs
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umar reported that on the day of Badr the Prophet cast a glance at the polytheists, who were one thousand, while his own companions were three hundred and nineteen, then turned towards the qiblah and made du'a to his Lord
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas reported the Messenger of Allah died when he was sixty-three years old, and so did Abu Bakr and Umar
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: A'isha reported the Prophet said the angels were created from light, the jinn from the spark of fire, and Adam from what has been described to you
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said that iman is to affirm your faith in Allah, in His angels, in His Books, in His Messengers, in the Day of Judgment, and to affirm your faith in the divine decree about good and evil
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdur-Rahman ibn Awf narrated the Prophet said Abu Bakr is in Paradise, Umar is in Paradise, Uthman is in Paradise, Ali is in Paradise, Talhah, az-Zubayr, Abdur-Rahman ibn Awf, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, Sa'id ibn Zayd and Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah are in Paradise
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Sa'id narrated the Messenger of Allah said Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn are the chiefs of the youths of Paradise
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Ibn Umar reported that in some of the Prophet's battles a woman was found killed, so the Messenger of Allah forbade the killing of women and children
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr reported the Prophet said whoever killed a person having a treaty with the Muslims shall not smell the smell of Paradise
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: The Prophet said Allah is more merciful to His slaves than this lady is to her son
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Buraida reported the Messenger of Allah said he who played Nardashir, a game similar to backgammon, is like one who dyed his hand with the flesh and blood of swine
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade
